conventions: Engine B. Weight e^{+S/hbar}; S = int dvol(-1/4 (F_A,F_A) + 1/2 (lambda, dslash_A lambda) + (d_A c, A*) + ([c,lambda],lambda*) + 1/2([c,c],c*)) [ESW (31)] dimensionally reduced to Euclidean R^4 (d only along R^4, A in V_10^vee (x) g, A_V its R^4 part, A_perp = W_R^perp part). Explicit realization (code only): S_+, S_- two-component blocks, sigma = (1, i sigma_k): S_+ -> S_-; W = C^4, W_R^perp realised on Wedge^2 W by antisymmetric 't Hooft blocks; Gamma^mu = gamma^mu (x) 1, Gamma^{4+i} = gamma_5 (x) gamma_6^i; Sigma = S_+(x)W + S_-(x)W^*. Contraction rule d_P(f_X f_Y) = P^{XY}; P(eps,infty) = N(q) e^{-eps q^2}/q^2 with N_AA = 2 (-,-)^{-1} (all ten components), N_{lam lam} = i rho(q)|_{Sigma*->Sigma} read in Sigma(x)Sigma via (-,-), N_{c A*} = N_{A* c} = -i q (-,-)^{-1} (A*_V only), all derived as -(Pi Hessian of the free action)^{-1} (Feynman gauge for A, ghost sector on Im Q^GF). One-loop formula (0-dim verified): W_1 = (hbar/2) sum_n (1/n) STr[(P Pi d^2 I)^n], Pi = parity operator. Fourier Phi(x) = int d^4p/(2pi)^4 e^{ip.x} Phi(p). c_adj = the scalar by which X -> sum_a [t_a,[t^a,X]] acts on simple g (t^a dual to t_a w.r.t. (-,-)); every colour factor reduces to c_adj (c1,c2) (bubbles: +1, quartic tadpoles: -1 per ([c1,t],[c2,t^]) contraction, checked on su(2), su(3) in non-orthonormal bases with rescaled pairings). Units: hbar c_adj/(16 pi^2) for eps^{-1} and log eps coefficients. I^CT[eps] = singular part of W_1 (I - I^CT[eps] is the regularised interaction). Method B: eps d/deps of each graph = -(sum over edges of the graph with that edge pinned at t_e = eps); pinned graphs expanded in eps (Taylor in external momenta), remaining t_f = eps u_f, exact u-integrals over [1,infty).

trace.decomposition: gamma = 2*(4 - 12) + 16*(-1) + 8 = -24; in terms of the standard coupling (hbar c_adj = -g^2 C_A/2 for (-,-) = (2 hbar/g^2) x positive Killing-normalised form) this is 12 g^2 C_A/(16 pi^2) = 3 g^2 C_A/(4 pi^2) [sanity check only]

route_i.formula: Delta.O[infty] = (Delta.O)[infty] - 2 hbar (d_delta I^CT)_log[infty] - 2 hbar sum_k b_k d^cross_{P(0,infty)}(B_k, O)   [from D_lambda^* P(eps,infty) = P(lambda^2 eps,infty), Delta.P = 2 eps L_eps, eps-independence of O[infty]; Delta.B3,5 = 2 B3,5 kill all eps^{-1} terms]; [(d_CE+Q)O[infty]](Delta) = Delta.O[infty] - Q O_1[infty], O_1 = -2 hbar d^cross_P(R,O), where sum_k b_k B_k = Q R, R = 2 int (A,A*) + (lambda, c parts), forced by the xi-linear equivariant master equation at scale infty: Q I^(1)(Delta) = Delta.I[infty] = -2 hbar Q R
route_i.scalar_bilinear: d^cross(B4,O) = 8 O; -Q O_1 = -8 u O; result: -(E+2)O + u[(-8+16-8) O + 4 (w1,w2) O_tr]  (u = hbar c_adj/16pi^2) => gamma_traceless = 0, gamma_trace = -24
route_i.general: gamma_O = 2 b'_O + 8 b_4 (scalar bilinears), gamma_letter = -b_X/k_X (k_X = coefficient of B_X in the free action)

route_ii.method: direct UV-boundary graphs: every edge replaced in turn by Delta.P = 2 eps L_eps (pinned at t_e = eps), exact Gaussian factor kept, finite eps (2e-2 ... 6.25e-4 for O graphs, 2e-3 ... 1.25e-4 for self-energy), random rational external momenta/polarisations, eps->0 by fit to 2a/eps - 2b + eps(c log eps + d)
route_ii.assembly: pinned 1PI O-loops -> -2u[4 O - 2(w1,w2) O_tr]; reducible chains O-P-(self-energy - I^CT): pinned loop edges + Delta.(-I^CT) -> -2 b_4 x (B4 kernel) per leg = +8u per leg (2a/eps pieces cancel exactly), pinned tree edge (Sigma - I^CT) 2 eps L_eps -> 0; plus the tree -Q O_1 = -8u O; total identical to route (i): gamma_traceless = 0, gamma_trace = -24

selection_rules: P_mu, M_munu, R^i_j (so(6)=sl(4)): H = Laplacian (x) id and Q^GF are Euclidean- and R-covariant, so (X(x)1+1(x)X)P(eps,infty)=0, X.K_eps=0, counterterms X-invariant => [(d_CE+Q)O[infty]](X) = (X.O)[infty] exactly: no one-loop correction for any local O; traceless and trace parts of Sym^2(W_R^perp) cannot mix.
Delta: regulator not covariant (Delta.P = 2 eps L_eps); computed: gamma_traceless = 0, gamma_trace = -24, letters gauge dependent.

K_mu (dimension -1, component of ghost degree |O|): anomalous part fixed by [K_mu,P_nu] = 2M_munu + 2 delta_munu E [SW (4)] to -2 gamma_O int omega x_mu O; a translation-invariant extra term would need a colour-singlet local vector of dimension w_O - 1: none exists for scalar bilinears or letters (the only dimension-1 vector is the adjoint A_V) => output = -2 gamma_O int omega x_mu O + Q-exact.

Q^i_alpha, Qbar_{alphadot i} (dimension +1/2, odd; component degree |O|): allowed outputs = fermionic colour-singlet local functionals of dimension w_O + 1/2 in S_+(x)W (resp. S_-(x)W^*) (x) R-rep of O: for the bilinears int omega (iota_w A, lambda) [classical type], gauge-variant int omega (A_V, rho(.) lambda), BRST-type int omega (c, lambda*) (dimension 0 + 5/2, degree 0); nothing else. Not excluded by covariance (linear supersymmetry does not commute with Q^GF); any such term is supported at t = eps.

S^alpha_i, Sbar^{alphadot i} (dimension -1/2): a translation-invariant output would need a fermionic colour-singlet local operator of dimension w_O - 1/2 = 3/2: none (lambda is adjoint, (c,lambda*) has dimension 5/2) => only x-weighted Q-type structures fixed by {K,Q} ~ S, plus Q-exact terms.
